messages:
Mazie: okay non-work announcement incoming — Sam proposed last night and I said yes!! :heart_eyes: I had to share :D
Derek: WOOO congrats!!! :tada: when's the big day?
Mazie: not set yet, probably sometime next summer. we're still figuring out travel/venues so expect lots of questions lol
Sarah: Mazie!! so happy for you. count me in for planning help / cake tasting :bride_with_veil:
Omar: huge congrats — drinks on Friday to celebrate? I can bring bubbly
Jen: yes to drinks. also thinking we should do a group card + team gift. who wants to chip in?
Chris: I'll toss in $25. happy to be point on the card and order a cake for the office next week
Mazie: omg thank you all. no pressure on gifts, seriously — your good vibes are enough. chocolate cake is my fave if we're doing one :chocolate_bar:
HR-bot: Congratulations Mazie! :tada: Reminder: if you plan to take honeymoon leave, submit time-off requests through the HR portal and check parental/secondary leave policies if relevant. Link: https://hr.redwood.example/policies/time-off
Rebecca-bot: Team gift page created: https://gifts.example/collections/mazie-2026 — please add contributions by Friday if you'd like to chip in :gift:
Derek: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/party-congrats-3oEduQAsYcJKQH2XsI
Jen: cake + bubbly Friday after work? office conf room or rooftop?
Omar: rooftop sounds nice if weather holds :sun_with_face:
Mazie: rooftop would be lovely but no expectations. honestly i'm just really excited and wanted to share. thank you all for being so sweet <3
Chris: congrats again Mazie!! :raised_hands:
Jen: ❤️❤️❤️
